parameters.query:
update public.automation_jobs
   set status = case when attempts >= max_attempts then 'failed' else 'pending' end,
       run_after = now() + make_interval(mins => least(60, power(2, attempts)::int)),
       last_error = $1,
       locked_at = null,
       locked_by = null,
       updated_at = now()
 where id = $2::uuid
 returning id, status, attempts;

insert into public.audit_logs (workspace_id, event_type, entity_type, entity_id, new_data)
values ($1::uuid, 'integration.failed', 'automation_job', $2::uuid, $3::jsonb);
